english_fragment: Example (perpetual futures) : in crypto_perps_funding , funding is a position-dependent cash flow that is part of the total return stream: a cost when paid and a benefit when received. Because it accrues only when a position is held at the funding timestamp and is settled under venue-specific conventions, the trading setup must specify (i) how trades and position changes are aligned to the funding snapshot, (ii) which pricing and funding formula (including any caps/floors) and fee schedule are assumed, and (iii) how convention changes are versioned. Otherwise, the same backtest can imply different effective exposures and produce materially different PnL.
